name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations Manager
summary: Marketing operations manager with 15+ years across agency and B2B environments, including 5+ years building and troubleshooting CRM and marketing-automation systems (GoHighLevel primary, hands-on HubSpot and Salesforce). Built lead nurture, email, and multichannel campaigns for B2B clients, architected 20+ automation workflows spanning capture, qualification, routing, and nurture, and maintained the data hygiene and lead scoring that keep those systems accurate. Comfortable troubleshooting a client's martech stack, building the dashboards that report on it, and presenting results to non-technical stakeholders on client calls.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system - 20+ workflows spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term nurture/reactivation, and automated review-generation.
Configure and troubleshoot CRM and automation systems (GoHighLevel, HubSpot) for B2B clients, resolving setup issues and martech-stack problems as they surface.
Architect CRM systems with contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols, keeping lead records clean and reporting comparable across accounts.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering results on a regular cadence during client calls.

Built segmented cold-email outreach engines (website-visibility, missed-calls, and low-reviews campaigns) plus an automated prospect-audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint to trigger outreach.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' goals into precise system configurations and workflows, bridging business intent and technical execution.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments and client stakeholders.
Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Produced landing pages and complex email sequences supporting lead generation and pipeline development.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation-management and marketing-automation tools as their primary point of contact.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (roughly 94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built and refined internal reporting processes at a performance marketing agency, improving accuracy and reducing handoff errors.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in workflow automation and pipeline configuration.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, advising clients on CRM adoption and operational system design.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
